node.title: Re^3: Any reference about %SIG
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I am looking for a document explains all the signals' meaning and trigger.

The signals special to Perl, like __WARN__ and __DIE__, are documented in [doc://%SIG], the other signals are generally POSIX signals, which you can read about for example in signal(7) like [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/signal.7.html|here] and [https://linux.die.net/man/7/signal|here], or in [wp://Signal (IPC)]. Note that a lot of signals may be OS-specific. If you could tell us what you want to use them for (and on which platforms), perhaps we can give more specific advice.
